paragraphs: The stock price of Fermi Inc. is 7.4 as of July 24, 2026, with a 12.46 percent increase from the prior close. Over a 20-session window, the price change is -15.91 percent. There has been one new news item in the last 24 hours.

There have been recent filings, including an 8-K form on July 23, 2026, which announced the appointment of four new officers, and an 8-K form on July 15, 2026, which disclosed the issuance of $431.25 million in aggregate principal amount of 5.00% convertible senior notes due 2031.
